raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
The 2-CTA SDPA stats census misses valid global-to-shared bulk copies emitted as `shared::cta` by newer DSL builds. Correcting that count alone still skips the reported build because only a 4.8.1 rendering record exists.

## Fix
Recognize both CTA and cluster destination spellings, and add measured per-kernel records for the exact 4.9 development build. Select records by full DSL version while keeping the existing 4.8.1 records and unknown-build skip guard.

Check the cast against each form’s exact record: its entry-region hash includes the following kernel’s `.globl` annotation, which differs between forms even with identical cast instructions. All owned-kernel hashes and opcode counts remain pinned.

## Manual verification
[PASSED] Five affected host-render tests on DSL 4.8.1 and five on `4.9.0.dev0+20261028185815.e475245` (with the matching libs and the reported libs-base build). Includes sm_100a, sm_103a, debug-clock, mask-form and stats-form checks; no skips.

The original matcher reproduces the zero-versus-one failure on the 4.9 build. Control checks reject corrupted hashes and skip unrecorded DSL versions. Matcher exclusion, Black/Black Jupyter, SPDX and whitespace checks pass.

These are host-compilation/PTX checks; numerical GPU execution and performance were not measured.

Created by dkg-ai-bugfix agent.

@RomanAnders90 @Anerudhan Could you please review this PR and merge it if everything looks good? Thanks!

Post-merge review. The fix is right and well documented: the census matcher now accepts both bulk-copy destination spellings, and the exact-version record selection keeps the unknown-build skip guard intact. Three small follow-ups, none blocking:

1. **Labels.** `AGENTS.md` § PR labels and the PR template ask for one `orig-*` label per PR; this one carries `cat-bug` + `area:*` only (every other merged PR in the 1.33.0 milestone has an `orig-*` label). `orig-nv-eng` looks right for the dkg-ai-bugfix agent unless maintainers want a dedicated originator label for agent-created PRs. Sibling fix PRs also use `cat-bugfix` rather than `cat-bug` (the issue-report label). The agent-generated body dropped the template checklist, so the label step was never self-checked; worth fixing in the agent so its PRs arrive fully labeled.

2. **Per-kernel md5 regions.** `ptx_kernel_md5s` hashes from a kernel's `.entry` line up to the *next* `.entry`, so every region ends with the following kernel's `// .globl <mangled name>` line. That is why the cast md5 differs between the two forms here, and the existing one-CTA record already pins the byte-identical `delta_zero_thd_d128_kernel` at two different md5s (`thd` vs `grouped_thd`) for the same reason. A signature change or reorder of a neighbour, including the excluded shared fold whose `.globl` sits inside the cast's region, reddens an unchanged kernel's row, which the per-kernel records were introduced to avoid. Dropping that trailing line (or ending the region at the closing `}`) would make every row self-contained and let the dropped `cast_ldg == cast_default` invariant come back, at the cost of re-pinning the 28 rows of the four record files once. Optional, and the hash stays a strict superset either way (false reds only, never a missed change).

3. **Record key on dev builds.** The selection and the skip guard key on the `nvidia-cutlass-dsl` metadata version, but that wheel is metadata-only; the PTX text comes from `nvidia-cutlass-dsl-libs-core` / `-libs-cu12|cu13` (plus `-libs-base`), and this record's own header shows the dev build carrying a different libs-base stamp. Release wheels pin the libs wheels with exact `==`, so only dev/nightly installs could see a same-DSL/different-libs md5 failure instead of a skip. Folding the libs versions (or the compiler DSO's `DSO_SHA256` fingerprint) into the `dsl=` key would make the dev-build pin honest too. This is the repo-wide record convention, so a separate issue if at all.

**Codex bot review · model: `gpt-6-astra`**

Reviewed `53de7dc0a754` against base `0d72d59efd21`.

Thank you for your contribution! No correctness findings in this test-only change. The broader copy matcher and exact-version record selection retain per-form kernel pins and the unknown-build skip guard.

Validation: Five affected host-render tests passed with DSL 4.8.1: SM100, SM103, debug-clock, mask-form and stats-form checks; no skips. Twelve independent control tests passed. Both records and forms select by exact version; corrupted, missing and extra kernel hashes fail; unknown versions skip; both plain-copy spellings match and unrelated transfer forms do not. Reviewed both changed files and the rendering/record helpers. Style and security workflows passed; no open CodeQL alerts.

Limitations: The exact development DSL build was unavailable from the configured package index, so its recorded hashes were checked structurally but not independently re-rendered. These are host compilation and test-contract checks, not numerical GPU execution or performance validation.

Approved: no P0 or high-risk P1 found. Remaining findings stay with the owner; merge timing stays with the owner.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+# sm_100a per-kernel records for the same B, H, HK = 2, 8, 2 host probe as the 4.8.1 record.
+# Rendered with DSL/core/cu12/cu13 4.9.0.dev0+20261028185815.e475245 and
+# libs-base 4.9.0.dev0+20261028231650.f53b4ff. The existing 4.8.1 records remain unchanged.
+# The default and ldg module md5s are 08de69e0b7ff99cd25d16655f77e3c98 and 147dcf653b367b6ee7c274c661f27025.
+# Entry-region hashes include inter-entry annotations: the following main kernel's .globl comment differs
+# between forms, so the cast's recorded hash differs even though its instructions are identical.
+# The shared dK/dV fold remains excluded, as in the release record.
+dsl=nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.9.0.dev0+20261028185815.e475245
+d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail sm_100a default kernel=setup_thd_d128_2cta_kernel rc=0 ptx_md5=8075cfdc6cf89caaff356b6592a377c1
+d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail sm_100a default kernel=delta_zero_stats_thd_d128_2cta_kernel rc=0 ptx_md5=f071bde8e8e6886a1a81f2d8e29f950c
+d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail sm_100a default kernel=bprop_d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_kernel rc=0 ptx_md5=5fe5958ad75736e880018e1cad2e3fa1
+d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail sm_100a default kernel=cast_dq_thd_d128_kernel rc=0 ptx_md5=f0e9582912436e349f41cf46951446e8
+d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_ldg sm_100a default kernel=setup_thd_d128_2cta_kernel rc=0 ptx_md5=dcd9250396ec5e1517be1c9fc8a18648
+d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_ldg sm_100a default kernel=delta_zero_thd_d128_kernel rc=0 ptx_md5=7451f8e1e48f06841bccba975577adbb
+d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_ldg sm_100a default kernel=bprop_d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_kernel rc=0 ptx_md5=a0d0a6a31e177669c74b362b04d4893f
+d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_ldg sm_100a default kernel=cast_dq_thd_d128_kernel rc=0 ptx_md5=e9ef2d7b511c0e01745fa84282e5a5d6

@@ -51,6 +51,7 @@
 _BODY_REL = pathlib.Path("python/cudnn/sdpa/bwd/kernels/sm100/bprop_d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_f16.py")
 _TREE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]  # test/python/sdpa/frost/<file> -> the checkout
 _RECORD = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "renderings" / "md5_d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_default_sm_100a.txt"
+_RECORD_DEV = _RECORD.with_name("md5_d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_default_sm_100a_dsl_4_9_dev_20261028.txt")
 _RECORD_TOKEN = "d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail"
 _RECORD_TOKEN_LDG = "d128_accum_grouped_2cta_stail_ldg"  # the stats_form = "ldg" rendering's rows (the previous default), beside the default's in the same file
 # The kernels the pair chain OWNS under the DEFAULT form (tma_ring: the delta-and-stats launch; one record row each; the group fold
@@ -104,7 +105,8 @@
 _STATS_CENSUS = {
     "bar_sync_1_256": r"bar\.sync\s+1,\s*256",
     "st_shared_b32": r"st\.shared\.b32",
-    "bulk_g2s_plain": r"cp\.async\.bulk\.shared::cluster\.global\.mbarrier",
+    # Non-multicast copies use either destination spelling, depending on the DSL build.
+    "bulk_g2s_plain": r"cp\.async\.bulk\.shared::(?:cta|cluster)\.global\.mbarrier",
     "mbarrier_init": r"mbarrier\.init",
     "ld_global": r"ld\.global",
     "fence_proxy_async": r"fence\.proxy\.async",
@@ -465,8 +467,14 @@ def _render_kernels(tmp_path, form_kw, extra_census=None):
 
 
 def _record_kernels(path, token):
-    """(dsl line, {kernel: md5}) of a per-kernel record's ``default`` variant (frost_test_utils.read_kernel_record)."""
-    dsl, want = read_kernel_record(path, token)
+    """Select the installed DSL build's record; an unrecorded build still reaches the existing skip guard."""
+    from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_state
+
+    _installed, version = cutedsl_state()
+    have = " ".join(version) if version else None
+    paths = (path, _RECORD_DEV) if path == _RECORD else (path,)
+    records = [read_kernel_record(candidate, token) for candidate in paths]
+    dsl, want = next((record for record in records if record[0] == have), records[0])
     return dsl, want.get("default", {})
 
 
@@ -669,7 +677,9 @@ def test_2cta_stail_host_renders_stats_forms_for_sm_100a(tmp_path):
     # the ldg chain's five launches: the compact delta launch; the main kernel and the setup kernel (no padded row-offset pass) render differently
     # from the default's, the dQ cast is the same kernel; the shared fold is rendered and excluded from the pin
     assert set(kernels_l) == set(_OWN_KERNELS_LDG) | set(D128_THD_SHARED_KERNELS), kernels_l
-    assert kernels_l[_OWN_KERNELS[2]] != kernels_d[_OWN_KERNELS[2]] and kernels_l[_OWN_KERNELS[3]] == kernels_d[_OWN_KERNELS[3]], (kernels_d, kernels_l)
+    assert kernels_l[_OWN_KERNELS[2]] != kernels_d[_OWN_KERNELS[2]], (kernels_d, kernels_l)
+    # Pin the cast independently in each form: its entry-region hash also includes the following kernel's .globl annotation,
+    # which can differ between forms even when the cast instructions are identical.
     _assert_record(kernels_l, _RECORD, _RECORD_TOKEN_LDG, "the ldg rendering")
     md5_c, census_c, regs_c = _render(tmp_path, {"debug_clk": True}, _STATS_CENSUS)
     assert census_c["clock64"] > 0 and md5_c != md5_d and regs_c == regs_d
